title: 9 Signs a Godly Man's Calendar Actually Belongs to God
caption:
A full calendar isn't the same as a faithful one.

Anybody can look busy. The question is who got the first slot, what he said no to on purpose, and whether he'd hand the whole week over without editing it first.

"Teach us to number our days, that we may get a heart of wisdom." Psalm 90:12

Stewardship starts with the hours, not just the money.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #discipline #stewardship
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
